description: Run one live Google SERP read per query (no 3-read merge, no averaging) and return ranked organic results plus SERP extras from the same response: feature types present, People Also Ask questions, related searches and the featured snippet. Saved as a research report. Paid: the account's own DataForSEO key or included platform credits, billed per request by DataForSEO. Without confirm:true it only returns a dry-run estimate with cache hits; confirm:true requires an idempotencyKey and respects maxCostUsd. Cached for 12 hours per account. Priority input only, never verification: a position snapshot is not proof a fix worked. Requires the research:write scope.
name: get_serp_results
title: Live SERP results for up to 10 queries
